 "data": "flowchart TB

 ANANSE[\"ANANSE TELECOM\"]
 WALLET[\"ANANSE WALLET\"]
 TRANSACTION[\"ANANSE TRANSACTION\"]

 CUSTOMER[\"CUSTOMER\"]

 SIKA[\"SIKACREDIT\"]
 SIKA_ACTIVITY[\"LOAN / REPAYMENT\"]

 OMAN[\"OMAN REMIT\"]
 REMIT[\"REMITTANCE\"]

 FINANCIAL_CONSEQUENCE[\"FINANCIAL CONSEQUENCE\"]

 ANANSE -->|\"owns and operates\"| WALLET

 CUSTOMER -->|\"participates in\"| TRANSACTION
 WALLET -->|\"used in\"| TRANSACTION

 SIKA --> SIKA_ACTIVITY
 OMAN --> REMIT

 SIKA_ACTIVITY -->|\"may produce\"| FINANCIAL_CONSEQUENCE
 REMIT -->|\"may produce\"| FINANCIAL_CONSEQUENCE

 FINANCIAL_CONSEQUENCE -->|\"may affect\"| WALLET

 NOTE[\"WALLET RELATIONSHIP PRINCIPLE<br/><br/>The wallet is a distinct financial object owned and operated by Ananse Telecom.<br/>Ananse transactions directly involve the wallet.<br/>SikaCredit and Oman Remit activities may produce financial consequences affecting the wallet.<br/>These cross-institutional relationships are conceptual and are not represented as direct<br/>SikaCredit → Wallet or Oman Remit → Wallet relational links.\"]",
 "config": null

div.div:
WALLET RELATIONSHIP PRINCIPLE
The wallet is a distinct financial object owned and operated by Ananse Telecom.
Ananse transactions directly involve the wallet.
SikaCredit and Oman Remit activities may produce financial consequences affecting the wallet.
These cross-institutional relationships are conceptual and are not represented as direct
SikaCredit → Wallet or Oman Remit → Wallet relational links.
